releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.47 — voice notes play again. A voice note from someone else is a file on a private endpoint: `GET /media/file/…` only answers a signed-in caller, and the Android player cannot attach the session token — it opened the URL anonymously, on the UI thread, and every remote clip ended in 'Couldn't play this voice message'. The clip is now fetched once through the logged-in connection into the app's cache and played from disk: taps start instantly, dragging the waveform seeks a local file instead of re-connecting, and a clip plays again offline. If a download really fails, the bubble says why ('the file is no longer on the server', 'this phone can't decode that voice message') instead of one catch-all error, and a spinner shows in the play button while the audio is on its way. The chat list also draws one icon per message now: older builds put a type emoji in the preview text (🎤 Voice message, 📷 Photo, 🎥 Video, 📎 document, 📍 Location) next to the icon the row already draws, so a single voice note showed two microphones. The marker is gone from the text and is also stripped from the previews already cached on the phone, so the list is clean immediately after updating.
